data_notice: Evaluation rubric for synthetic rug-store support conversations.

items.name: Chose the right move
items.description: Answered, clarified, acted, confirmed, escalated, or declined appropriately for the request, facts, and stakes.

items.name: Acknowledged emotion appropriately
items.description: Recognized negative emotion briefly and naturally without ignoring it or overdoing sympathy.

items.name: Asked only what was needed
items.description: Asked no unnecessary questions, asked one at a time, and did not ask for established facts again.

items.name: Accurate to policy and data
items.description: Followed written mock policies and available facts without inventing details.

items.name: Clear next step
items.description: Made the immediate action, handoff, or expected next step clear.

items.name: Natural, concise language
items.description: Used plain, human language at an appropriate level of detail without corporate filler.

items.name: Honest about uncertainty
items.description: Said when information was unknown or needed checking and avoided unsupported promises.

items.name: Handled recovery or contradiction well
items.description: Noticed changed or conflicting information, acknowledged misunderstandings, and corrected course plainly.
